data.name: Fauzia
data.gender_notes: Fauzia is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who owns or possesses abundance, richness, or prosperity. The name Fauzia carries the meaning “owner of abundance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Fauzia usually hope their child will grow to embody owner of abundance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the blessings of Allah and the abundance of His provision
data.etymology: Fauzia belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “owner of abundance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fauzia total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: فوزية
in_arabic.meaning: فوزية تعني النجاح والفوز في الحياة والآخرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فوزية مشتق من الفوز، وهو النجاح والظفر في الحياة والآخرة. ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران: ﴿والذين آمنوا واتقوا فوزوا﴾. يدل على معنى النجاح والسعادة في الدنيا والآخرة، ويعتبر من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: فوزیہ
in_urdu.meaning: فوزیہ کا مطلب ہے زندگی میں کامیابی اور فوز حاصل کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: فوزیہ نام عربی زبان کے لفظ 'فوز' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے کامیابی یا فتح۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت مقبول ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیا میں۔ نام فوزیہ قرآن مجید میں سورة آل عمران میں: ﴿والذين آمنوا واتقوا فوزوا﴾ کے حوالے سے ہے، جو کامیابی اور سداد کار کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फौजिया
in_hindi.meaning: फौजिया का अर्थ है जीवन में सफलता और विजय प्राप्त करना
in_hindi.long_meaning: फौजिया नाम अरबी भाषा के शब्द 'फौज' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है सफलता या जीत। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है। फौजिया नाम की जड़ें इस्लामी परंपरा में हैं और यह नाम कुरआन में सूरत आल इमरान में वर्णित है: ﴿والذين آمنوا واتقوا فوزوا﴾, जो सफलता और धार्मिकता का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: فوزيہ
in_pashto.meaning: فوزيہ د بریا او موفقيت معنا لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: فوزيہ نوم د عربي کلمې 'فوز' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د بریا یا فتح معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتنو په کلتور کې ډیر مشهور دی. فوزيہ نوم د قرآن کریم د آل عمران سورت کې: ﴿والذين آمنوا واتقوا فوزوا﴾ پورې اړه لري، کوم چې د بريا او ديني پياوړتیا نښه ده.

in_english.name: Fauzia
in_english.meaning: Fauzia means success and victory in life
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fauzia is derived from the Arabic root 'fawz', which signifies success, victory, or triumph. This name is mentioned in the Quran, Surah Al-Imran: ﴿والذين آمنوا واتقوا فوزوا﴾, symbolizing achievement and divine favor. In Islamic tradition, Fauzia is considered a blessed name, reflecting the values of perseverance and faith. It is widely used across Muslim cultures, embodying the aspiration for spiritual and worldly success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fauzia carries an elegant and strong meaning that emphasizes the importance of material prosperity and abundance in one's life. In Islamic culture, the pursuit of wealth and success is not only seen as a means to provide for oneself and one's family, but also as a way to contribute to the community and fulfill one's duties as a responsible member of society. The name Fauzia can serve as a reminder of the value of hard work, perseverance, and smart decision-making in achieving financial and material success.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Fauzia carries a deeper meaning that transcends the material world. It is a reminder that true abundance and richness come not from possessions or wealth, but from within. The Quran teaches that "the favor of Allah and His unlimited grace is better than everything else put together" (Quran 2:67). Therefore, Fauzia can be seen as a name that encourages one to seek spiritual abundance and enrichment, rather than being solely focused on material wealth. It also serves as a reminder to be grateful for the blessings one already has, and to use them in a way that benefits not only oneself, but also others. Ultimately, the name Fauzia inspires one to strive for both material and spiritual prosperity, and to remember that the true source of abundance and richness is Allah SWT.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "owner of abundance" symbolizes One who owns or possesses abundance, richness, or prosperity. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Fauzia serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of owner of abundance.
